title: Method version
purpose: Create a laboratory method version or edit an existing version. Editing adds usage facts, lock explanations and history.
summary: Create a method version or edit an existing one. For an existing version the page also shows what uses it, which values are locked and its history. Only admins can save.

tasks.title: Add a method
steps: Enter the method code, the lab's version text and the title.
Optionally add the source or SOP reference, reference source and technique, then select [[Create method]].

tasks.title: Retire a version for new work
steps: Uncheck availability for new work, give a [[Reason for change]] and select [[Save changes]]. Existing work keeps its reference.

tasks.title: See the tests for this version

good_to_know: Code, version, title and source reference lock once work depends on the version. Start a new version instead.
Versions are not numbered automatically. Use the lab's own revision, edition or year.
Reference source and technique describe the record only. They are not printed on reports.
If someone saved the record after you opened it, your save is refused. Reload and compare before entering the change again.

sections.title: Fields and related work
paragraphs: Method code, Version, Title and Source or SOP reference lock once work depends on the version directly or through definitions. Policy-only configuration does not lock method identity. Reference source, Technique and Availability remain editable with a reason. Saved text is trimmed.

items.label: Method code
items.description: Required, up to 60 characters. Code and version together are unique ignoring case.

items.label: Version
items.description: Required, up to 40 characters. Use the lab’s revision, edition or year text; versions are not assigned automatically.

items.label: Title
items.description: Required laboratory method title, up to 200 characters.

items.label: Source or SOP reference
items.description: Optional citation or SOP number/revision for provenance.

items.label: Reference source
items.description: Optional, from a fixed list (EPA, Standard Methods, EPA SW-846, ASTM, USGS, Laboratory-developed (SOP), Other); Not recorded leaves it blank. Records who publishes the method and filters the Methods list. It describes the record only: it is not printed on reports and is not part of what locks when work depends on the record, so it stays editable with a reason.

items.label: Technique
items.description: Optional, from a fixed list (for example ICP-MS, Ion chromatography, Titrimetric, GC-MS); Not recorded leaves it blank. Filters the Methods list and can be shown beside tests. It describes the record only: it is not printed on reports and is not part of what locks when work depends on the record, so it stays editable with a reason.

items.label: Active (available for new work)
items.description: Checked initially. Retiring removes this version from new sample requests and batches; existing work keeps its reference.

items.label: New version
items.description: Edit-only action to create a separate version using this code.

items.label: View this version’s tests
items.description: Edit-only link filters Tests to this exact version, when dependency facts are displayed.

sections.title: Saving and history
paragraphs: A record changed since opening cannot be overwritten. Submitted input remains on the error page; reload and compare current values before re-entering the intended change. Records are retained rather than deleted.

items.label: Create / Save changes
items.description: Only administrators submit. Creation is audited; an existing change records before/after values and requires a reason. An unchanged submission returns to the list with No changes to save and adds no edit event.

items.label: Reason for change
items.description: Existing records only: explain any changed value or availability decision.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the corresponding list without saving.

items.label: What depends on this
items.description: Counts referring records. Methods/analytes also show active tests out of all tests. These facts can include more dependencies than list work counts.

items.label: Locked values
items.description: Dependent identity values become read-only facts with lock reasons. Locks are rechecked when saving, including concurrent references.

items.label: History
items.description: The newest 20 audit events appear in chronological order with actor, timestamp and reason.
